email.invalid: Invalid email, it must contain 5 to 25 letters, optionally followed by up to 5 digits, and use gmail, yahoo or icloud with .com or .net (e.g. example12@gmail.com)

password.weak: Password must contain at least one lowercase letter, one uppercase letter, one number and one special character
password.min: Password must be at least 8 characters
password.max: Password must be at most 16 characters
password.mismatch: Password does not match confirm password

username.min: Username must be at least 2 characters
username.twoParts: Username must include 2 parts (first name and last name)

firstName.min: First name must be at least 2 characters
firstName.max: First name must be at most 30 characters

lastName.min: Last name must be at least 2 characters
lastName.max: Last name must be at most 30 characters

phone.invalid: Invalid phone number, use international format like +201234567890

error.forbidden: You do not have permission to access this resource
error.tokenExpired: Your session has expired, please login again
error.tokenRevoked: This session has been logged out, please login again
error.invalidProvider: This email is registered with a different sign-in method
error.rotateTooEarly: Cannot create new login credentials while the current access token is still valid

success.gmailLogin: User logged in with Gmail successfully
success.gmailSignup: User signed up with Gmail successfully
